company.name: Momentus
company.shortDescription: Momentus is a commercial space company providing satellite buses, in-space transportation, hosted payloads, and in-orbit services.
company.description: Momentus is a U.S. commercial space company that plans to offer in-space infrastructure services, including in-space transportation, hosted payloads and in-orbit services. Momentus believes it can make new ways of operating in space possible with its planned in-space transfer and service vehicles that will be powered by an innovative water plasma-based propulsion system that is under development.

productsAndServices.description: An orbital transfer and service vehicle that transports satellites and hosted payloads between orbits, deploys customer spacecraft, and supports selected in-orbit operations.
productsAndServices.name: Vigoride Orbital Service Vehicle

productsAndServices.description: A point-to-point orbital transportation service that moves and deploys customer satellites or payloads in their desired orbit.
productsAndServices.name: Delivery Service

productsAndServices.description: A hosted-payload service providing orbit transfer, maintenance, attitude control, power, communications, and payload data support throughout a customer mission.
productsAndServices.name: Hosted Service

productsAndServices.description: A commercial smallsat bus based on Momentus’ Vigoride platform for satellite missions requiring an integrated spacecraft bus and orbital transportation capabilities.
productsAndServices.name: M-1000 Commercial Satellite Bus

productsAndServices.description: Services performed in space that support payload and spacecraft operations, including orbital maneuvering, maintenance, attitude control, and communications support.
productsAndServices.name: In-Orbit Services
